tools.name: assess_pronunciation
tools.description:
Assess English pronunciation quality from audio.

Scores pronunciation at four levels: overall, sentence, word, and phoneme.
Each score is 0-100. Phonemes are returned in both IPA and ARPAbet notation.
Sub-300ms inference latency.

Args:
    audio_base64: Base64-encoded audio data. Supports WAV, MP3

tools.name: check_pronunciation_service
tools.description:
Check if the Brainiall Pronunciation service is healthy and ready.

Returns:
    dict with keys:
        - status (str): 'healthy' or error state
        - modelLoaded (bool): Whether the scoring model is loaded
        - version (str): API version

tools.name: get_phoneme_inventory
tools.description:
Get the full phoneme inventory supported by the pronunciation scorer.

Returns a list of all English phonemes the engine can assess, including
ARPAbet symbol, IPA equivalent, example word, and phoneme category
(vowel, consonant, diphthong).

Returns:
    list of dicts, each with keys:
        - arpa

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description:
Transcribe audio to text with word-level timestamps.

Converts spoken English audio into text with optional word-level timestamps
and per-word confidence scores.

Args:
    audio_base64: Base64-encoded audio data (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, WebM).
    audio_format: Audio format hint. Auto-detected from ma

tools.name: check_stt_service
tools.description:
Check if the Brainiall Speech service is healthy and ready.

Returns:
    dict with keys:
        - status (str): 'healthy' or error state
        - modelLoaded (bool): Whether the speech-recognition model is loaded
        - version (str): API version

tools.name: voice_id_enroll
tools.description:
Enroll a voiceprint for a speaker from ~2s of clear speech. Repeat with more clips to strengthen it.

Only an irreversible embedding is stored — never the raw audio.

Returns:
    dict with keys: speaker_id (str), n_samples (int), enrolled (bool).

tools.name: voice_id_verify
tools.description:
1:1 verification — is this clip the enrolled speaker?

Returns:
    dict with keys: similarity (float), match (bool), threshold (float).

tools.name: voice_id_identify
tools.description:
1:N identification — rank everyone enrolled in the group against this clip.

Returns:
    dict with keys: candidates (list of {speaker_id, similarity}, best first).

tools.name: voice_id_list_speakers
tools.description:
List the speakers enrolled in a group.

Returns:
    dict with keys: speakers (list of {speaker_id, n_samples, ...}).

tools.name: synthesize_speech
tools.description:
Generate natural speech audio from English text.

Produces high-quality speech with 12 English voices.
Returns base64-encoded WAV audio (16-bit PCM, 24kHz mono) along with metadata.

Available voices:
- af_heart (default), af_bella, af_nicole, af_sarah, af_sky (American female)
- am_adam, am_michael

tools.name: list_tts_voices
tools.description:
List all available Brainiall Voice synthesis voices with metadata.

Returns:
    dict with keys:
        - voices (list): Available voices, each with id, name, gender, accent, grade
        - defaultVoice (str): Default voice ID

tools.name: check_tts_service
tools.description:
Check if the Brainiall Voice service is healthy and ready.

Returns:
    dict with keys:
        - status (str): 'healthy' or error state
        - modelLoaded (bool): Whether the synthesis model is loaded
        - version (str): API version

tools.name: transcribe_audio_pro
tools.description:
Transcribe audio with Brainiall Speech Pro — multilingual transcription.

Supports 99 languages with automatic language detection, word-level
timestamps, per-word confidence scores, and optional speaker diarization
(identifies who spoke each word). Best-in-class WER (~2%).

Args:
    audio_base64: B

tools.name: check_whisper_service
tools.description:
Check if the Brainiall Speech Pro service is healthy and ready.

Returns:
    dict with keys:
        - status (str): 'healthy' or error state
        - modelLoaded (bool): Whether the Brainiall Speech Pro engine is loaded
        - diarizeLoaded (bool): Whether the diarization pipeline is loaded
